The published open-ink attack successor requires a fresh animation handoff selecting its exact key/hash, unchanged open-ink-v2 base binding, all six approved motion bindings, and unchanged true-alpha selection. The v14 handoffs and blocked authoring identity remain immutable.

seojin.attack.motion_bindings.dynamic_pi.value: Bounded open-ink and pastel accents support the slash but are excluded from root, baseline and scale measurement and never become background.

value.policy: all anchors remain continuous across the provider-native GIF timeline

value.pose: Quiet right-facing ready stance with fixed support foot and pelvis; sword and scabbard controlled close to the body.
Compact anticipation: knees and hips load while the root and baseline remain unchanged.
Acceleration begins through pelvis and torso; the hwando enters one continuous rightward cutting path.
Decisive contact peak: one strong readable rightward slash with fixed support and coherent blade alignment.
Immediate controlled stop with only bounded ink and garment lag; no second attack.
Balanced recovery guard preserving direction, identity, equipment, root, baseline and scale.

seojin.attack.motion_bindings.motion_dir.value: One coherent right-facing decisive slash progresses once through anticipation, acceleration, contact, stop and recovery without root translation or a second attack.

seojin.attack.motion_bindings.sword_arc..value: One bounded rightward cutting trajectory; the hwando remains continuous with hand, scabbard and equipment identity and stays inside the safe margin.

seojin.attack.motion_bindings.torso_rota.value: Pelvis initiates, torso and shoulder follow, and the blade resolves into one controlled contact and recovery while support remains grounded.

value: 최우선으로 전신은 cranial mass 상단–턱 아래 head height와 cranial mass 상단–weight-bearing sole full-body height로 측정하여 4.0–5.0 heads 범위, 목표 4.25 heads의 젊은 성인 한국 남성으로 읽혀야 한다.
얼굴·복식·한쪽 어깨 갑옷은 high-signal 열린 먹선과 넓은 안료 mass로만 단순화하고, 갑옷은 끊긴 식별 edge를 가진 one broad dusty gray-brown shoulder mass 하나로 보여야 한다.
예상 실루엣과 내부 경계 길이의 35–55%를 생략하고 목표 45%로 하여 정체성 anchor를 보존하는 open/broken contour를 유지해야 한다.
먹선은 가변 압력과 굵기, 보이는 brush start, directional drag, dry end 및 directional weight를 가져야 한다.
watercolor와 pastel 안료는 few broad rough masses로 적용하고 선택된 외곽선 밖으로 bounded controlled bleed와 controlled misalignment를 허용해야 한다.
faded blue-gray/indigo, dusty gray-brown, small muted ochre를 승인된 서로 다른 캐릭터 anchor 역할로 유지해야 한다.
figure interior와 full canvas 각각 최소 70%를 무채색 또는 미채색의 broad negative space로 유지해야 한다.
젊은 성인 한국·조선 정체성, 낮은 상투, 단순한 한쪽 어깨 갑옷 mass, 왼쪽 허리의 칼집에 든 환도와 손잡이에 얹은 오른손이 모두 보여야 한다.

Preserve the approved Seojin young-adult Korean/Joseon identity, compact 4.25-head proportion, low topknot, simplified one-shoulder armor, left-waist sheathed hwando, open broken mok-seon, and restrained indigo, gray-brown and ochre pigment roles without redesign.

Deliver one RGBA PNG whose every pixel outside the intended character, equipment and controlled pigment silhouette has alpha exactly 0; artistically bounded partial alpha is allowed only inside that intended foreground.
Keep the complete figure, hwando, scabbard, equipment and controlled pigment inside the canvas with at least 24 pixels of clear safe margin and no clipping.
Generation and preservation must validate alpha-mask, fringe and safe-bound evidence before declaring the replacement preview or package complete.
